pointers.sentence: `TemplateDoesNotExist` and `TemplateSyntaxError`, the exceptions of `django/template/exceptions.py`, and the debug information the Django template language puts on an exception when the engine's `"debug"` option is on: the template, the line and the failing tag, at compile time and at render time.
`TemplateSyntaxError` adds nothing to `Exception` (`django/template/exceptions.py:TemplateDoesNotExist`).

The base loader records each origin it tries as `"Source does not exist"`, or as `"Skipped to avoid recursion"` when an `{% extends %}` asked it to skip that one (`django/template/loaders/base.py:Loader.get_template`).

`Engine.find_template` joins its loaders' lists (`django/template/engine.py:Engine.find_template`), and the `DjangoTemplates` backend raises a copy that names the backend (`django/template/backends/django.py:reraise`).

`Engine.find_template` joins its loaders' lists (`django/template/engine.py:Engine.find_template`), and the `DjangoTemplates` backend raises a copy that names the backend (`django/template/backends/django.py:reraise`).

`get_template` and `select_template` of `django/template/loader.py` ask the engines in turn and raise an exception of their own whose `chain` holds each engine's (`django/template/loader.py:get_template`).

`get_template` and `select_template` of `django/template/loader.py` ask the engines in turn and raise an exception of their own whose `chain` holds each engine's (`django/template/loader.py:get_template`).
The debug page lists the chain, or the exception alone (`django/views/debug.py:ExceptionReporter.get_traceback_data`).
The `Jinja2` backend gives none when it turns a `jinja2.TemplateNotFound` into a `TemplateDoesNotExist` (`django/template/backends/jinja2.py:Jinja2.get_template`).
`Engine.select_template`, which `{% include %}` uses, raises one holding the names alone (`django/template/engine.py:Engine.select_template`).

And the cached loader with `"debug"` off keeps only the class for a missing name, and on later requests raises a new one holding the name alone; with `"debug"` on it keeps a copy, list included ([Finding a template: `Engine` and the loaders](loaders.md)) (`django/template/loaders/cached.py:Loader.get_template`).

For a partial the template does not define, `Engine.get_template` gives as `tried` a list holding the template's name, a string where the page expects a pair (`django/template/engine.py:Engine.get_template`).

`Token.position`, the token's start and end offsets in the source, is set only by `DebugLexer`, which its docstring calls slower than the default lexer, and `Template.compile_nodelist` uses it only when `"debug"` is on (`django/template/base.py:DebugLexer.tokenize`).

`Parser.error` puts the token on the exception, in an attribute named `"token"`, unless one is there, so that the innermost tag is blamed (`django/template/base.py:Parser.error`); `Parser.extend_nodelist` sets the token and the origin on each node (`django/template/base.py:Parser.extend_nodelist`).

`Parser.error` puts the token on the exception, in an attribute named `"token"`, unless one is there, so that the innermost tag is blamed (`django/template/base.py:Parser.error`); `Parser.extend_nodelist` sets the token and the origin on each node (`django/template/base.py:Parser.extend_nodelist`).

It keeps up to ten lines either side as `"source_lines"`, and adds `"line"`, `"message"` (the exception's first argument) and `"name"` (the origin's) (`django/template/base.py:Template.get_exception_info`).
`Template.compile_nodelist` catches what the parser raises and, with `"debug"` on, adds the dictionary (`django/template/base.py:Template.compile_nodelist`).

The message as raised stays in the dictionary and in an attribute named `"raw_error_message"`, which the debug page shows as the exception's value (`django/views/debug.py:ExceptionReporter.get_traceback_data`).

Loaded with `"debug"` on by `django.template.loaders.locmem.Loader`, which names an origin by the template's name where the filesystem loader uses the file's full path, it raised a `TemplateSyntaxError` (`django/template/loaders/locmem.py:Loader.get_template_sources`, `django/template/loaders/filesystem.py:Loader.get_template_sources`):

`NodeList.render` calls `Node.render_annotated` on each node, which calls `Node.render` and, if that raises while `"debug"` is on, annotates the exception on its way out (`django/template/base.py:Node.render_annotated`).

The test of origins matters under inheritance: `ExtendsNode.render` walks the parent's tree with the parent as the render context's template, and the child's blocks render inside that walk (`django/template/loader_tags.py:ExtendsNode.render`).

`copy_exception` copies `"template_debug"` with the declared attributes: a `TemplateDoesNotExist` from an `{% include %}` of a missing template is annotated at the tag before the backend's wrapper raises a copy naming the backend (`django/template/backends/django.py:copy_exception`).

`PartialTemplate.get_exception_info` loads the whole template again through the origin's loader and asks it (`django/template/base.py:PartialTemplate.get_exception_info`, [Template partials: `{% partialdef %}` and `{% partial %}`](partials.md)).

The `Jinja2` backend builds the dictionary from a Jinja2 syntax error met as it loads a template by name or renders one, and puts it on a `TemplateSyntaxError` raised from it; other errors in a Jinja2 template get none (`django/template/backends/jinja2.py:Jinja2.get_template`, `django/template/backends/jinja2.py:Template.render`, `django/template/backends/jinja2.py:get_exception_info`).

And a lookup that ends in an exception, silenced later or not, is logged at the debug level on the `"django.template"` logger, with the traceback and the name of the template the render began with (`django/template/base.py:Variable._resolve_lookup`).
